crosswalks.label: Management Analysts
crosswalks.rationale: Management Analysts ground process/governance analysis while Model Governance Specialist narrows to model inventory, lifecycle gates and accountability records.

crosswalks.label: Computer and Information Systems Managers
crosswalks.rationale: CIS Managers ground technology responsibility context but do not define model-governance evidence or risk authority.

findings.summary: Model governance should make ownership, inventory, review, monitoring, exception and decommission processes traceable while keeping process compliance separate from substantive model-quality, safety, legal and risk decisions.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the specialist boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make governance-process-versus-professional-acceptance and model/use identity-drift boundaries explicit before relying on lifecycle gates.

nonclaims: No complete Model Governance Specialist reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, user, legal, platform or institutional authority is created.
